title: A Bakery Started A War
description:
The Pastry War (1838-1839): Mexican officers trashed a French pastry chef's shop, and he billed them 60,000 pesos. France demanded 600,000, blockaded Mexico's ports and bombarded Veracruz. Mexico's General Santa Anna lost a leg to French cannon fire. Britain mediated and Mexico agreed to pay. In 1842 Santa Anna gave the leg a state funeral.

Sources: Wikipedia (Pastry War; Battle of Veracruz 1838), History.com, Mexico News Daily. Dates for the looting vary by source (1828 or 1832). Dialogue-free dramatisation; the leg funeral is documented.

What is the silliest reason for a war you've heard? Tell us in the comments.
